components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with teal accent fill. Pill-shaped.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary outline button with surface background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'SpaceGrotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(0.98); } .dark .ds-btn-secondary { background: #151A21; color: #F4F6F8; border-color: #2A3441; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default card container with soft shadow and 12px radius.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(8,145,178,0.12); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'SpaceGrotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #0F172A; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #475569; margin: 2px 0 0 0; } .dark .ds-card { background: #151A21; border-color: #2A3441; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .dark .ds-card-title { color: #F4F6F8; } .dark .ds-card-body { color: #9AA5B1; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with pill-like rounding and bordered style.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'SpaceGrotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #475569; padding: 0 12px 4px; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 24px; border: 2px solid #E2E8F0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0891B2; } .dark .ds-input-label { color: #9AA5B1; } .dark .ds-input { background: #151A21; border-color: #2A3441; color: #F4F6F8; } .dark .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2BB5D6; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .dark .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5E6B7A; }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Bottom navigation as a floating pill with animated indicator.
components.html: HomeExplore
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { display: flex; flex-direction: row; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 36px; padding: 10px 6px; box-shadow: 0 10px 16px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); position: relative; align-items: center; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 0; text-decoration: none; z-index: 1; } .ds-tab span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: #94A3B8; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-tab-active span { color: #0891B2; opacity: 1; } .ds-tab-indicator { position: absolute; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; width: 60px; left: 8px; border-radius: 30px; background: rgba(8,145,178,0.12); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .dark .ds-tab-bar { background: #151A21; box-shadow: 0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .dark .ds-tab span { color: #5E6B7A; } .dark .ds-tab-active span { color: #2BB5D6; } .dark .ds-tab-indicator { background: rgba(43,181,214,0.16); }

narrative.overview: Prophetize is a prediction market that needs to feel trustworthy enough for virtual money but approachable enough for casual daily use. Like a well-kept financial ledger: precise, clean, and calm. Every screen communicates clarity over cleverness — no user should wonder what something does or where to tap next. The system uses a restrained cyan-teal accent on a neutral base, soft card layering with subtle shadows, and a type system that contrasts bold Space Grotesk headings with readable Inter Tight body text. It explicitly rejects over-simplified AI-generated interfaces, clashing multi-color palettes, and noisy or complicated layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained single-accent palette on tinted neutrals
Card-based layout with soft shadow elevation (flat at rest, lifted on interaction)
Bold sans-serif headings + humanist sans body + monospaced data labels
Full light/dark mode support with independent color values per theme

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: The teal accent covers ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point. When something needs emphasis, use weight or scale — not an extra color. Secondary and tertiary are role-specific, never decorative.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as elevation cues for interactive or overlaid elements. Cards do not float arbitrarily — shadow signals 'this can be interacted with' or 'this is on top of other content.'

dos: Do use the teal primary sparingly — ≤10% of screen area. It should feel like a highlight, not a default.
Do use secondary (amber) for second-level actions, tags, and warm accents.
Do use tertiary (violet) only for premium/special elements — it's the rarest color in the system.
Do use JetBrains Mono for all numeric displays (balance, percentages, scores, timestamps).
Do keep card radius at 12px consistently. Mixing 8px and 12px creates visual noise.
Do use dark mode shadows with higher opacity (0.35+) — the dark canvas absorbs shadow.
Do tint neutrals toward cool (not warm) — it complements the teal accent.
donts: Don't use more than one accent at full saturation on the same surface. Primary, secondary, and tertiary are role-specific — they never compete.
Don't use secondary or tertiary as decorative flair. Each has a functional role.
Don't use hard-coded colors — always reference UI_COLORS or AppTheme tokens.
Don't leave text without an explicit color — default black breaks in dark mode.
Don't add decorative gradients, glassmorphism, or 3D effects. Flat with shadow is the language.
Don't use complicated or noisy layouts — clarity and simplicity first per the brand principles.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe. Use full borders or background tints.
Don't create nested cards — cards should be siblings, not parents and children.
Don't use arbitrary font sizes like [10px], [11px], [13px] — stick to the modular scale defined in tailwind.config.js.
